title: House and tree
subtitle: A tiny house with a round roof, and a tree beside it. 7 pieces, 5 steps.
note: BinBuild's own arrangement of the 7-piece house-and-tree set (piece list from the kit). Placements: x and y in studs, z in plates.

steps.text: Lay the long green plate flat on the table. That's the grass.
Put the 2 orange bricks side by side at one end of the plate. They cover 4 studs: these are the walls.
Put the 2 black curved pieces on top of the walls, tall ends touching in the middle. That's the roof.
Skip one stud, then put the grey round brick on the last stud. That's the tree trunk.
Put the green round plate on top of the trunk. That's the treetop.
